verdict.rationale: Recruitee lists a first-party 'Reporting & Insights' feature, so recruiting analytics is part of the product, but the evidence is only a feature-page heading with no detail on which metrics or breakdowns it provides. Missing for 10: documented stage-conversion reporting, time-to-hire metrics, source-effectiveness analytics, offer-accept rates, per-role and per-team breakdowns, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I see the hiring funnel honestly — stage conversion, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and offer-accept rates per role and team
